fulfillment_judgment.auxiliary_material: Findings on antibiotic pretreatment reducing metabolite levels and therapy efficacy, and the mechanistic association between butyrate supplementation and JAK-STAT pathway inhibition in mouse tumor cells.
fulfillment_judgment.outline_action: Search for clinical cohort studies or guideline documents that specify absolute concentration reference ranges and standardized assay protocols for inosine and short-chain fatty acids in human serum or tumor tissue.
fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: No standardized measurement protocol, reference range, or consensus statement for human tumor microenvironment or serum metabolites (inosine, short-chain fatty acids) is provided; the study is confined to mouse models and does not address inosine quantification or human physiological standards.
fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: This study describes the application of UHPLC-MS/MS to quantify short-chain fatty acids (specifically butyrate) in mouse plasma and feces, and GC-MS for tumor tissue, reporting measurable concentration changes linked to anti-PD-L1 therapy outcomes in a syngeneic NKTCL mouse model.
